answer: For agents relaying a river flood signal to a summit station, assign paid jobs through a lottery weighted by locked stake. Freeze the stake registry before an unpredictable public draw, and count every locked coin once across all keys. Splitting a deposit among aliases leaves its total chance unchanged; new accounts receive no free tickets. An attacker seeking more jobs must acquire and immobilize more capital for the full service period. This removes the gain from extra names, though a wealthy operator can still buy a large share.
